About the founder

The story behind Intentionaire by MHG Group.

I started MHG Group because I saw a beautiful bar and grill close down without ever getting to try it. A place with a soul, gone before I ever walked through the door. That’s when I knew — I was going to build the room I wished existed.

Intentionaire was built so nothing gets made without intent behind it. Every piece, every color, every detail has a reason.

Jewelry that says where your head is at before you say a word. Wear what you feel. The future is more human, filled with more intention than ever before.
